text: でも　この　わざが　また　つかえるんだよなー！

structure.jp: でも　この　わざが
また　つかえるんだよなー！

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んだ, short for のだ, adds a feeling of 'the thing is...' when explaining something. つかえるんだ = 'the thing is, it's useful'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: The える ending turns 'use' into 'can use', which also means 'is handy'. つかえる = 'is useful'.

patterns.name: 〜よな
patterns.explanation: よ and な together at the end say something firmly while half talking to yourself, like 'you know, huh'. つかえるんだよなー = 'it really is useful, you know'.
